title: Title: KuCoin Global Trading Clash: Join Team "Perun The Trader" – Let’s take the 50,000 USDT prize pool! 🏆
author: azagor
selftext:
The **KuCoin Global Trading Clash** is officially live, and I’ve set up team[ Perun The Trader](https://peruninthemachine.com/#products) to take on the leaderboard.

There’s a **50,000 USDT total prize pool**, with **20,000 USDT** reserved for the 1st-place team, and the top 20 teams will split the rewards. Whether you trade spot or futures, your volume counts directly toward our ranking.

**Event Timeline:**

* **Ends:** October 16, 15:59 (UTC)

**What We Need to Qualify:**

* **Team Size:** At least 5 active members.
* **Personal Volume:** Minimum **1,000 USDT** in trading volume during the event period to be counted as an eligible member.
* **Team Goal:** Push past the **3,000,000 USDT** total team volume milestone to secure our qualification spot.

If you’re already active on KuCoin or planning to take trades this month, don't leave free rewards on the table. Join the roster, hit the 1k volume threshold, and let’s climb into the top 20 together.
